notes.title: Trap Labs v1.2 is here! Release celebration 50% off for limited time!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/54953c6f83860a767089d18f22050bd11d40e206.png[/img]
Holy this took long. Nevertheless, here it is Trap Labs v1.2! I've update the Steam store page as well with new gameplay clips, store descriptions, and gifs. Check those out!

To celebrate this release, Trap Labs is 50% off on Steam for two whole weeks! New content and a discount? Can this day get any better?!

Anyways, onto the new stuff!

[h1]Character Customization[/h1]
Billy now comes with 6 different colors schemes available from the game start. There are over 30 different hats to collect throughout story mode. The character customization screen can be accessed from the pause menu. You can swap hats and color in realtime during multiplayer. Showoff your hard earn hats to your friends.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/98e752da1d7da97265c265dc54459f97f49f3685.gif[/img]

[h1]Multi-resolution and Windowed Full Screen[/h1]
All monitor resolutions are now supported. Check out this ultrawide screenshot. It's so pretty. In addition, the game can now be set in windowed full screen (aka borderless window). This is important for streamers.

[h1]Arcade Reorganization[/h1]
The original 100 levels of Level Up has been split into easy, normal, and hard. These are ~33 levels each. This should make it easier for people to try it and not get intimidated by the difficulty. The original full versions are still available.

[h1]Multiplayer Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Asia server.
[*]Players can now spectate other players once the level is complete.
[*]Multiplayer nickname now hard-binds to Steam.
[*]Level Up mode now keeps track of player scores in multiplayer.
[*]Multiplayer race and co-op now support passworded private sessions.
[*]Level select screen now shows if a floor currently is being played.
[*]Your player name is now bigger and highlighted in different color.
[/list]

[h1]Story Mode Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Story medal stats can now be accessed by clicking on the medal icon.
[*]You can now rewatch a cutscene/splash screen by clicking on the movie clip icon beside key levels.
[*]As mentioned earlier, all hats are collectable through story mode levels. They are place in difficult to reach places. See if you can find them all!
[*]Many of the story levels has been tweaked for to reduce frustration, especially the more difficult ones.
[*]Wall clipping in many levels are fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Mobile Cross-play[/h1]
This release launches simultaneously with the first ever iOS and Android builds. The first 25 story levels on mobile are available for free, including online play. The whole game can be unlocked by a single in-app purchase. There are no ads or other in-app purchases. If you've never played Trap Labs and want to give it a go, mobile is a great way to sample the game.

[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1201374945]App Store (iOS)[/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codensuch.TrapLabs]Google Play[/url]

Let me know what you think! If you run into any issues be sure to let me know! You can reach me directly at traplabsgame@gmail.com, or just drop a message in the forums.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/859cb321e9541450bf77fb7c40cbfd10042d61d8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Trap Labs 1.2v beta now live (pw: dontStormArea51)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/b9a21c0b02dea0e49714352defaf061f1f5cbf65.png[/img]
Anyone who wishes to join the beta can do so by using the password [b]dontStormArea51[/b]. Mobile betas are also available through invite only. PM me or send email to traplabsgame@gmail.com for mobile invite.

[i]To access the beta, right click on Trap Labs in your Steam library, go to Properties, click on the Betas tab, and enter the password dontStormArea51. Select the v1.2beta from the drop down menu.[/i]

[h1]v1.2 Notes[/h1]

[b]Hats & Customization[/b]
Hats are now accessible via the person icon in the pause menu. Hats are collectable throughout the 100 story levels. There are over 30 hats to collects. More will be added as time goes on. Many of the hats were suggested and inspired by friends who have streamed Trap Labs in the past. If you want a hat, you know, you just have to stream the game :P

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/98e752da1d7da97265c265dc54459f97f49f3685.gif[/img]

Billy now has 6 different colors to pick from. You may also notice there is a selector under Billy's name that is disabled. I've added the infrastructure to support additional characters but I have yet to add a new character. Characters like PART and Mei will be playable in a future patch.

[b]Full multi-resolution support[/b]
No more black bars! This was a tedious feature to implement but long overdue. It works great on my ultrawide (3440 x 1440). If you have a 4k monitor let me know if it works.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/54953c6f83860a767089d18f22050bd11d40e206.png[/img]

You'll also discover that there's an option for windowed (borderless) full screen. It currently does not work, but will be added before the final v1.2 release.

[b]Arcade Reorganization[/b]
Level Up is a lot of fun, but it gets hard real fast. So I've split up the mode into 3 varying difficulty each with their own leaderboard. This way it gives player an easier and quick sense of satisfaction from completion rather than having to go through all 100 levels.

In addition, leaderboard now offers an option to display only score among friends.

[b]Multiplayer Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Players can now spectate other players once the level is complete.
[*]Multiplayer nickname now hard-binds to Steam. So you can't change your nickname to something obscene. Thanks.
[*]Level Up mode now keeps track of player scores in multiplayer.
[*]Multiplayer race and co-op now supports passworded/private sessions.
[/list]

[b]Story Mode Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Story medal stats can now be accessed by clicking on the medal icon.
[*]You can now rewatch a cutscene/splash screen by clicking on the movie clip icon beside key levels.
[*]As mentioned earlier, all hats are collectable through story mode levels. They are place in difficult to reach places. See if you can find them all!
[*]Many of the story levels has been tweaked for to reduce frustration, especially the more difficult ones.
[/list]

These are the major additions and changes. There are many small quality-of-life changes and fixes not mentioned. See if you can discover what they are :)

Leave me feedback and comments here! For a more personal chat come to the discord 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/859cb321e9541450bf77fb7c40cbfd10042d61d8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Updates, fixes, and what's coming
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941537/b0c8d40dc527393cb7aa805d295361a2b1fdfa85.png[/img]

Hello labrats! In case you didn't know, all patch notes are located in the Steam community forums. In case you have an issue with the game please direct your questions and comments there.

Here are some highlights of game changes since the game release:
- Added "carry mode" for co-op. As long as one person wins the level everyone wins
- Fixed achievements not triggering (you should be able to get all the visible achievements now) You don't have to replay the game just beat one level if something didn't trigger before.
- Fixed many crashes and bugs related to co-op and multiplayer stability
- Gold medals are all achievable now, some were impossible to achieve during launch but they have been fixed.

What's to come:
- I'll be adding servers to Europe and Asia
- Adjustments to certain levels that are too frustrating

Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Trap Labs Demo and Steam Keys Giveaway!
notes.content:
A new Trap Labs demo has been released! The art was completely redone, and many new features were added. The game looks and feels completely different. I wrote a new story with a silly and comedic premise and decided that the flat cartoon style of the early 2000s would work nicely. The art is heavily influenced by shows like Fairly OddParents, Dexter's Lab, and PPG.

The demo includes 26 hand crafted levels made just for the demo, 5 bonus challenges, and one multiplayer map available for testing. Let let us know if you have feedback in the community forums!

To celebrate the release of the new demo we will be giving away the full game to 14 people and up to 2 of their friend upon final release!
